Stone Pelting on Chhattisgarh CM's Convoy; Accusations Against BJP

Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel's convoy was targeted with stones in Assam, resulting in broken vehicle windows. Police reportedly used batons to control the situation. Baghel alleged that the police, administration, and Election Commission were acting like BJP workers. The incident involved clashes between BJP and Congress workers.
